name: Golden Cream Cake
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Beat yolks of eight eggs to the lightest possible cream
Add two cupfuls of sugar and a pinch of salt
Sift three teaspoonfuls of baking powder well with flour
Make an icing of the whites of three eggs and one pound of sugar
Spread icing between the cakes and sprinkle grated cocoanut thickly over each layer

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Beat yolks of eight eggs to the lightest possible cream
2. Add two cupfuls of sugar and a pinch of salt
3. Sift three teaspoonfuls of baking powder well with flour
4. Bake in three jelly-cake pans
5. Make an icing of the whites of three eggs and one pound of sugar
6. Spread icing between the cakes and sprinkle grated cocoanut thickly over each layer
